items.summary: ZDNET 文章指出 agentic AI 规模化的真正瓶颈不是模型，而是数据底座。建议企业先做四件事：盘点 agent 实际要消费的领域数据、收敛口径并建立语义层、补齐权限与血缘治理、把数据 SLA 与 agent 调用链路绑定。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: Salesforce 拟收 Contentful,补齐 Headless 360 内容层
items.summary: The Register 6 月 2 日援引分析师称，Salesforce 拟收购 Contentful 为 Headless 360 补内容层，Benioff 上周财报会披露 Anthropic 客户 Headless 360 使用量 5 倍增长，该产品把 Salesforce 数据嵌入 WhatsApp、Slack、ChatGPT、Claude。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: B2B 一方数据如何激活：从合规底线走向收入增量
items.summary: Martech.org 提出 B2B 一方数据激活的三个抓手：打破数据孤岛用 Zapier/Webhook 串联自动化平台与 CRM；区分 Implicit/Explicit/Product-led 三类 intent 分别触发不同流程；AI 做个性化伙伴但 governance 由 Marketing/Legal/Product 共管。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: Meta 将 WhatsApp 商业版 AI 客服 Agent 向全球开放
items.summary: Meta 宣布 WhatsApp Business AI Agent(Meta Business Agent)全球上线，可自动回答客户问题、推荐产品、预约、销售线索筛选并转人工。同步上线 Instagram DM。正在测试夜间对话日报和竞品情报功能，计划接入 Shopify、Zendesk 等第三方系统，按 token 用量向大企业收费。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: 零售商用 AI 生成广告需直面版权与肖像权三重风险
items.summary: Hunton Andrews Kurth 律师 6 月 3 日撰文提醒零售商,生成式 AI 广告输出常与训练语料"实质性相似",版权方可凭反向图像检索追责,且执法对象往往是零售品牌而非 AI 供应商。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: 5 月全球 VC 融资 920 亿美元创年内次高，Anthropic 一家拿走 54%
items.summary: Crunchbase 5 月复盘：全球初创融资 920 亿美元仅次于 2 月，同比 +284%。Anthropic 单笔 500 亿美元占当月 54%,估值跃至 9650 亿美元超过 OpenAI 成第二大独角兽，6 月 1 日已提交保密 IPO。Cerebras AI 推理需求驱动 IPO 开盘 350 美元市值约 490 亿。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.
